lines.t: The time has come and is already here, when all shall be fulfilled; behold, the consummation of all things is at hand! The time has come for the stone to grow very heavy, a yoke upon the necks of all nations. And though many shall gather together seeking to cast it off, they shall be broken in pieces. For they shall stumble, they shall fall, and the weight of their rebellion shall crush them in the day of their calamity, when the foolhardy come out to fight against Me.
For I shall stretch out My hand against the nations,
And My strength shall be made fully known...
Behold, My name shall resound in all the earth,
From the uttermost isles even unto the beloved city...
Therefore let the nations be awestruck
In astonishment at the power of The Lord!
Let all people be utterly amazed at the mighty works
Of The Holy One of Israel!...
